method: Original paper pages and relevant proof sections read; no full copyrighted paper copied into packet.

papers.title: Nash Equilibria in Competitive Societies
papers.scope: Section 2.3, static valid utilities and submodular welfare; no inference that an SPE leaf is a static Nash equilibrium.

papers.title: The Sequential Price of Anarchy
papers.scope: Machine cost sharing and cut games statements and proof mechanisms; later positive-cost externalities differ from diluted coverage profit.

papers.title: Sequential Auctions and Externalities
papers.scope: v2, Theorems 3.2 and 3.4, unit-demand versus submodular sequential-auction assumptions; value after winning is retained.

papers.title: Bayesian Sequential Auctions
papers.scope: Theorem 3.1 and bluffing proof, independent buyer types and bound 2e/(e−1); not older 3 claim.

papers.title: Composable and Efficient Mechanisms
papers.scope: v1 Theorem 5.2 and appendix proof: unit-demand max across mechanisms and complete contingency-plan deviations.

papers.title: On the Sequential Price of Anarchy, Brethouwer thesis 2018
papers.scope: Sections4,6,7: downward-closed market sharing, asymmetric covering counterexample, shared misery and singleton/availability assumptions.
